shots.purpose: Establish Mara's isolation and the unusual controls
shots.action: Mara enters, folds her cane, and raises the access card toward the dead panel.
shots.camera: Locked wide from the rear corner; the panel and doors remain visible.

shots.action: Mara whispers a private fact; one floor button illuminates without being touched.
shots.camera: Static medium profile holding Mara and the panel in the same plane.

shots.action: Mara gives a false confession. The lit button goes dark and the lift drops; she braces against the rail without exposing the hidden card.
shots.camera: Handheld medium close shot with one short downward jolt motivated by the drop.
